tier_selection_rule: ez-wo15b-skyrme-massfit-prereg-v3-tier-rule: a parameter is identifiable when a 2% step inside its bounds moves the mean binding energy of the probe set by at least 50.0 keV. The largest nested tier whose parameters are all identifiable, and whose sensitivity vectors are not pairwise collinear above 0.98, is frozen. Ties go to the smaller tier: fewer degrees of freedom is the conservative error
